cues.en: Mike: Now I'm going to show you how to implement the Mann-Whitney U test.
cues.zh: Mike：現在示範 Mann–Whitney U 檢定的實作。

cues.en: Remember, this is the non-parametric alternative to the two-samples T-test, and it's specifically for the unpaired T-test.
cues.zh: 記住，這是雙樣本 t 檢定的無母數替代，特別用於不成對檢定。

cues.en: So, where you have two distinct groups.
cues.zh: 也就是兩個不同群組。

cues.en: All right, so let's begin.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: I'm going to generate the data here.
cues.zh: 先產生資料。

cues.en: It's actually a pretty similar way to how I generated the data in the previous code video about the Wilcoxon signed-rank test.
cues.zh: 方式和前一部 Wilcoxon 符號等級程式影片相當類似。

cues.en: Except, so it's similar in the sense that I'm generating Poisson random distributions with different lambda parameters.
cues.zh: 類似之處，是產生不同 λ 的隨機卜瓦松分布。

cues.en: The difference here is that I'm using different sample sizes.
cues.zh: 差別是，使用不同樣本大小。

cues.en: Now obviously you can't have different sample sizes when you have paired groups.
cues.zh: 成對群組顯然不能有不同樣本數。

cues.en: Okay, and here I'm visualizing the data.
cues.zh: 這裡視覺化資料。

cues.en: And again, each data point is represented as a dot.
cues.zh: 每個資料點用一個點表示。

cues.en: Of course, I'm not drawing lines between them because these are all separate data points.
cues.zh: 當然沒有連線，因為是各自獨立的資料點。

cues.en: So the lines between them would be misleading, but also just weird because Poisson numbers can only be integers.
cues.zh: 連線會誤導，而且很奇怪，因為卜瓦松數字只能是整數。

cues.en: Okay, and then again, I'm also adding some random offset to each data point on the X-axis.
cues.zh: 同樣，也為每個點在 X 軸加入隨機偏移。

cues.en: And that's pretty important for showing data like this to take on only integer value because, so I'm gonna just illustrate this,
cues.zh: 對這種只取整數的資料，很重要，示範一下。

cues.en: maybe I'll do it like this.
cues.zh: 也許這樣做。

cues.en: So you see there's only 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 unique values in this data set.
cues.zh: 資料集中只有 1、2、3、4、5、6 種不同數值。

cues.en: So it's unclear how much data we actually have here because they're all overlapping perfectly.
cues.zh: 因為完全重疊，看不出實際有多少資料。

cues.en: So, good reason why it's useful to offset a random amount.
cues.zh: 這就是隨機偏移有用的好理由。

cues.en: Okay, and then, let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: So this is easy to confuse signrank and ranksum.
cues.zh: signrank 和 ranksum 容易混淆。

cues.en: I have to admit that I have gotten confused between these once or twice before.
cues.zh: 必須承認，以前混淆過一兩次。

cues.en: Fortunately, if you have differences in sample sizes, then the signrank test is actually going to produce an error.
cues.zh: 幸好，樣本數不同時，signrank 會出錯。

cues.en: And the error is that the data vectors have to have the same number of elements.
cues.zh: 錯誤訊息是，資料向量必須有相同元素數。

cues.en: And that makes sense because the signrank test is only for paired sample data.
cues.zh: 合理，因為 signrank 只適用成對樣本資料。

cues.en: So the right test is actually called ranksum.
cues.zh: 正確檢定其實叫 ranksum。

cues.en: And I have this comment here.
cues.zh: 這裡有註解。

cues.en: This is exactly the same text as in the code for the Wilcoxon signed-rank test.
cues.zh: 和 Wilcoxon 符號等級程式中的文字完全相同。

cues.en: So it's just to remind you which tests you should use.
cues.zh: 提醒你應該用哪個檢定。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: It turns out that these data are significantly different.
cues.zh: 這些資料顯著不同。

cues.en: So the lambda parameters are different.
cues.zh: λ 參數不同。

cues.en: And you also see that here, the concentration of values is a little bit higher here and it's a little bit lower over here.
cues.zh: 這裡數值集中位置較高，另一邊較低，也看得出。

cues.en: So I'm going to simulate these data in a pretty similar way to how I generated the data in the previous code video.
cues.zh: 接著以和前一部程式影片很相似的方式模擬。

cues.en: That was for the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, in the sense that I'm generating random Poisson numbers with a different lambda parameter.
cues.zh: 之前是 Wilcoxon 符號等級，同樣產生不同 λ 的隨機卜瓦松數字。

cues.en: One difference between that previous video is that here I have different sample sizes for the two groups.
cues.zh: 差別是，這裡兩組樣本數不同。

cues.en: Now, of course that makes sense for the Mann-Whitney U test because the Mann-Whitney U test is a non-parametric alternative to the two-samples T-test
cues.zh: 這對 Mann–Whitney U 合理，因為它是雙樣本 t 檢定的無母數替代，

cues.en: only for unpaired samples.
cues.zh: 只適用不成對樣本。

cues.en: So when you have unpaired samples, obviously the sample sizes can differ.
cues.zh: 不成對樣本的樣本數顯然可以不同。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm plotting them again.
cues.zh: 再畫圖。

cues.en: So let's look at the plot.
cues.zh: 看看圖。

cues.en: Here you see the data one, that should probably say data1, like that.
cues.zh: 這裡是 data one，應該寫 data1，像這樣。

cues.en: So this is group one and group two.
cues.zh: 這是第一組、第二組。

cues.en: And you see that I'm drawing them as individual markers without lines connecting them, which makes a lot of sense, partly because these are all individual data points.
cues.zh: 畫成個別標記，沒有連線，很合理，一方面因為是個別資料點。

cues.en: And partly because with Poisson numbers we only get integers.
cues.zh: 另一方面，卜瓦松數字只有整數。

cues.en: So it doesn't even make any sense to draw lines here.
cues.zh: 在這裡畫線根本沒意義。

cues.en: And you know, mislead people into thinking that there could be an intermediate value of 2.47, for example.
cues.zh: 會誤導人，以為可能有 2.47 這種中間值。

cues.en: Okay, and then you can also see how this random X-axis offset here.
cues.zh: 也可以看到，這裡有隨機 X 軸偏移。

cues.en: Now sometimes that's just kind of helpful.
cues.zh: 有時只是稍有幫助。

cues.en: In this particular case because we have only integer values, that's actually really, really useful.
cues.zh: 這個只取整數的情況，卻非常有用。

cues.en: So I can show you what this will look like without that random offset.
cues.zh: 展示沒有隨機偏移時的樣子。

cues.en: So I'm just gonna multiply only this one by zero and it's basically just because I'm, you know, it takes less time to do that than it does to select
cues.zh: 只把這個乘以 0，只是因為這比選取

cues.en: and delete all of that text.
cues.zh: 並刪掉整段文字更快。

cues.en: So the thing is, there's only 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 unique data values in this entire data set.
cues.zh: 整組資料只有 1、2、3、4、5、6 種不同值。

cues.en: With a total of 30 data points, there's only six unique values.
cues.zh: 總共 30 個資料點，只有六種不同值。

cues.en: So without that random X-axis offset, we actually have no idea how many data points are in each of these, or take on each of these values.
cues.zh: 沒有 X 軸隨機偏移，就不知道每個值各有多少資料點。

cues.en: So that's an illustration of why adding this random x axis offset is so useful.
cues.zh: 這說明了加入隨機 X 軸偏移有多實用。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's run the statistical test.
cues.zh: 現在執行統計檢定。

cues.en: And it's called this pretty helpful name, the manwhitneyu test.
cues.zh: 函式名稱很有幫助，叫 mannwhitneyu。

cues.en: And we input our two data sets like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣輸入兩組資料。

cues.en: And here I'm printing out the U statistic and the P value.
cues.zh: 這裡印出 U 統計量和 P 值。

cues.en: And the P value is less than 0.05, so we can draw the conclusion that these data likely come from populations with a different median.
cues.zh: P<0.05，所以可以得出結論，這些資料很可能來自中位數不同的母體。
